description: QZ Tray signing certificate and private key (P6-T5). The key stays on the server; the POS asks the server to sign QZ requests.

fields.description: Public certificate (PEM) that QZ Tray trusts, e.g. digital-certificate.txt from QZ or your own self-signed cert.
fields.label: Certificate

fields.description: Matching RSA private key (PEM, unencrypted). Stored encrypted; only used server-side to sign QZ requests (SHA512).
fields.label: Private Key

fields.options: Leave both empty to run QZ Tray unsigned (every till shows QZ's trust prompt). Turn QZ on per POS Profile with QZ Print, QZ Host and QZ Printer; printing falls back to network/browser printing when QZ is not reachable.

name: NDS QZ Settings
